purpose: Each rule in the agent guides and the strongest layer that enforces it. A rule enforced by a check names the files that fail when it is broken; a judgment call says why no check can catch it; anything else is prose only, the last layer of the pyramid. scripts/quality/scorecard.mjs reports the shares.
